constraints.description: Every fact must reference source evidence; unsupported LLM claims are rejected, never stored as truth.
Never overwrite original source values with normalized values; retain both.
Use deterministic code for arithmetic, unit conversion, and comparison; LLMs handle semantics only.
Embeddings are for candidate discovery, never final truth determination.
Starter datasets stay outside the repo at ../starter-datasets; no dataset-specific production logic.
No Neo4j/Redis/Kafka/Celery/Kubernetes without a demonstrated need.

decisions.rationale: Simplest reviewer-friendly workflow for a take-home; chosen by maintainer over uv/Poetry.
decisions.title: Dependency management: pip + requirements.txt

decisions.rationale: Phase 0 is connectivity foundation only; domain schema arrives with Phase 1/Phase 4 when requirements are concrete.
decisions.title: Defer domain tables and migrations to Phase 1/4

decisions.rationale: Maintainer requested machine-readable JSON with stable node/relationship IDs at docs/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.json.
decisions.title: Knowledge graph representation: JSON

decisions.rationale: Standard FastAPI/Postgres stack; pgvector integrates cleanly; avoids extra infrastructure.
decisions.title: ORM: SQLAlchemy 2.0 + psycopg

decisions.rationale: Readiness probes must distinguish a live app from a down dependency; never 500 on DB outage.
decisions.title: /health always 200 with nested database status

decisions.rationale: Proper revisions from the start; avoids create_all tech debt with 8 entity groups ahead.
decisions.title: Migrations: Alembic from day one

decisions.rationale: Prototype scale (<=100 pages); background worker only on demonstrated need per PLAN.
decisions.title: Synchronous POST /documents ingest

decisions.rationale: Re-ingest-stable IDs; uuid4 document scope keeps bundles isolated.
decisions.title: Deterministic uuid5 evidence IDs

decisions.rationale: Never synthesize source numbers; starter PDFs carry no /PageLabels so None is correct.
decisions.title: source_page_number best-effort via PDF page labels, else None

decisions.rationale: No binaries in git; starter PDFs manual-validation only via DATASET_DIR.
decisions.title: Test PDFs generated in-test via PyMuPDF

decisions.rationale: TEXT preserved untouched; no schema change needed (meta/bbox columns already generic); gating avoids running pdfplumber on all pages.
decisions.title: Additive TABLE + TABLE_CELL evidence via pdfplumber with candidate gating

decisions.rationale: No cloud calls or credentials; provider abstraction keeps the engine replaceable; Docker pre-warms weights; hermetic auto-disable keeps tests deterministic.
decisions.title: Local PaddleOCR fallback instead of cloud OCR

decisions.rationale: LLM proposes drafts, deterministic code disposes; evidence IDs enforced, numerics/dates parsed locally, no fabrication.
decisions.title: Evidence-scoped Gemini drafts with deterministic validation

decisions.rationale: Nullable future columns avoid a second migration; link table gives relational provenance; entities stay embedded until reasoning.
decisions.title: facts + fact_evidence tables with reserved normalization columns

decisions.rationale: Comparison layer must receive ready-canonical values; canonical scales fixed per currency/family in code tables; FY stays dateless; uncertainty via flags with no schema change.
decisions.title: Deterministic canonical conversion without LLM or migration

decisions.rationale: Embeddings rank, structured fields decide; unknown passes through; uncertainty explicit via NEEDS_REVIEW; cross-document only.
decisions.title: Staged discovery plus deterministic precedence classification

decisions.rationale: Deployment has no GPU; +cpu local-version pin makes CUDA resolution impossible; pip cache mount survives failed builds.
decisions.title: CPU-only PyTorch with cached builds

invariants: Original source values are preserved alongside normalized values.
Context is checked before declaring contradiction.
Every relationship must be explainable and grounded in evidence.
Extraction failures are explicit (FAILED/PARTIAL with preserved evidence), never silent.
